items.content_html: Lightweight TypeScript library for generating MongoDB-compatible ObjectId strings in the browser. It produces 12-byte identifiers in both hexadecimal (24-character) and compact base64-like formats. Designed for frontend use, it requires no dependencies and uses modern Web APIs like crypto.getRandomValues for secure randomness.
